mechanism_overview.name: Wild gathering
mechanism_overview.gate: branches/seeds regrow; biome seeds; tree destruction wood/leaves; specific palm/fern/herb/cinchona/bamboo interactions

mechanism_overview.name: Fishing cages and rods
mechanism_overview.gate: water subtype and probabilistic catches; cage waits18000-24000 ticks; rods have separate conditions

mechanism_overview.name: Animal harvest
mechanism_overview.gate: dead unclaimed carcass, sharp held tool, adjacency and wait; meat type conditional pig/chicken/crab/poison frog; mammal anatomy offal; size bounded1..8; skin selects pelts/leather/bone

mechanism_overview.name: Animal milk/wool/eggs
mechanism_overview.gate: species and life/state conditions; milk udders, sheep shearing, chicken egg production; egg products indexed separately; output list omits unresolved egg constructor type

mechanism_overview.name: Dynamic farming harvest
mechanism_overview.gate: growth stage, living crop, sampled nutrition/water, season and biome; nominal plant_harvest_mappings not availability proof

mechanism_overview.name: Dehydrator, fermentation, canning, compost, print
mechanism_overview.gate: dynamic/in-place production branches; lexical appendix preserves source expressions for expansion

mechanism_overview.name: Clay firing
mechanism_overview.gate: new CL.result dynamic output; claybricks fired creates twice; type declarations resolve products

mechanism_overview.name: Generic roasting

mechanism_overview.name: Chemical machinery
